decision: Close variable-rank layer-one joint feature learning without variants. The train and validation misses are both broad, so another optimizer, epoch, or rank change is not justified. Authorize one read-only two-arm source-functional transplant diagnostic behind the passing layer-zero prefix: exact source block 1, and existing compact layer-one attention followed by exact source MLP 1. This isolates prefix propagation, attention compression, and residual-function compression without retaining or promoting source blocks.
claim_boundary: Negative mixed-rank two-layer prefix evidence only; no checkpoint, complete artifact, autonomous quality, physical runtime, Phase 3, or superiority claim.
